FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part 7 ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 20 September 1983, after the draft finalized by the Microwave Components and Accessories Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. 0.2 This standard ( Part 7 ) covers the requirements tubing, circular waveguides. for hollow metallic

12.1 Nominal Internal Diameter and Operating Frequency Range To permit selection of optimum waveguide sizes two overlapping series are listed. Cutoff frequencies for the TE,, ( dominant mode ), TM,,, TEtI) TEo, and TEez modes are shown. The recommended frequency range for the TEa1 mode operation is within 1'15 times the cutoff frequency for the TEll mode and 0'95 times the cutoff frequency for the TE-1 mode. The recommended frequency range for the TE,l mode operation is within 1'21 times the cutoff frequency for the TEol mode and 0 9 1 times the cutoff frequency for the TE, mode. *Specification for hollow metallic waveguides: Part 1 General requirements

For sizes C 190 and smaller, tolerances are under consideration. 12.3 Theoretical Attenuation - The values given in Table 1A are based on a figure for resistivity of copper of 1.724 1 x 10"SZm and apply to a frequency equal to 1'23 ( for TEII mode). For general case, attenuation is calculated by the formula given in 9.3.1 of IS : 4493 ( Part 1 )-I979 *. For other materials, the figures quoted should be multiplied by the values specified in 5.1 of IS : 4493 (Part I)-1979*.
NOTE - The values of attenuation given in Table 1A are for 100 percent copper. For other materials these values can be calculated using the formula given below [ see also 9.3 of IS : 4493 ( Part 1 )-1979* ] : This formula do not apply for thinly plated surface. 1. All Samples a) Visual examination

9.4.1

The waveguides shall be visually examined and condition, design, workmanship, finish and markings shall be satisfactory. There shall be no burrs, cracks, pits or Both other irregularities of the surface. inner and outer surfaces shall have a clean bright appearance in accordance with current engineering practice and shall be free from oxidation Besides this, the dimension and tolerance thereon shall conform to values given in Table IA of this standard. And the ellipticity E shall not exceed 0'001 at any cross-section for types C3'3 to Cl65 inclusive NOTE - For sizes Cl90 and smaller dimensions, the requirement for ellipticity is under consideration
